title: Hail, Love Divine! Joys Ever New
description: Hail, Love Divine! Joys Ever New in Tonic Solfa to HOLY MATRIMONY, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: Thomas Blacklock wrote these words. They were printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 774 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “Christian Beneficence”.

The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Particular Metre (8.8.6.8.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to HOLY MATRIMONY; any other Common Particular Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Hail, love di-vine! joys ev-er new, While thy kind dic-tates we pur-sue, Our souls de-light-ed share, Too high for sor-did minds to know, Who on them-selves a-lone be-stow Their wish-es and their care.

lines: Hail, love divine! joys ever new,
While thy kind dictates we pursue,
Too high for sordid minds to know,
By thee inspired, the generous breast,
Delights the widow's tears to stay,
To teach the blind their smoothest way,
In others' joys and griefs to share,
Each low, each selfish wish control,

licence: Public domain: Thomas Blacklock died in 1791.
credits: Words by Thomas Blacklock (1721–1791), public domain, as printed in Hymns for Christian Devotion (1853); set to HOLY MATRIMONY by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
